lifecycle.startHint: Start the live app using Agent-App's build and launch steps.
lifecycle.stopHint: Stop the live app and its CraftBot request bridge. Development instances keep running.
lifecycle.failed: Agent-App could not complete the command.
lifecycle.unknown: Connection interrupted. The command may still be running. Check the app status after reconnecting before trying again.
lifecycle.remaining: A development instance or task bridge is still running.

registry.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? The app will be stopped and its files removed. Its data and backups will be kept in Agent-App's removed-app archive.
registry.keepFilesMessage: Agent-App cannot verify ownership of "{{name}}"'s folder, so it has not deleted any files. Remove the app from the list instead? Its folder and data will stay on your computer.
registry.unregistered: Removed {{name}} from the app list. Its files were kept.
registry.deleteFailed: The app could not be deleted.
registry.forgetMessage: Remove "{{name}}" from the app list? Its app folder is missing. This clears the saved entry without deleting any files.
registry.title: Discovered apps

view.title: App view
view.chatFailed: Could not open the app conversation.
view.stopped: This app is stopped. Use Start to run it here.
view.missing: This app's folder is missing. Restore it to its registered location, then retry.
view.unreachable: The app is unavailable or its address is answering as another app. Check it through Agent-App, then retry.
view.notRegistered: This app is no longer registered at this location.
view.identityChanged: The app at this location has changed.
view.separateView: This app has a separate interface address that Agent-App does not yet provide to CraftBot.
view.failed: Couldn't check this app. Retry when Agent-App is available.
view.frameFailed: The app view hasn't finished loading. Retry to check the app and load its view again.

registry.disconnected: Connection lost. App status may be out of date.

requests.intro: {{name}} is asking CraftBot to work on a request. Allow requests from this app?
requests.scope: CraftBot can use this app to handle its requests. Access to local files and commands is controlled separately in app settings.
requests.allowed: Requests are now allowed. CraftBot will pick up the waiting request.

triggerConsent.title: Agent App requesting access to CraftBot
triggerConsent.intro: Once allowed, {{name}} can send these requests to CraftBot at any time:
triggerConsent.approvalSaved: Requests are now allowed. Try the action again.
triggerConsent.on: This app can send approved requests to CraftBot.
triggerConsent.pendingChanges: New or changed agent requests are off until you review them.
triggerConsent.off: Agent requests are off until you review and allow them.
triggerConsent.blocked: {{name}} couldn't run a request because permission is required.
triggerConsent.blockedHint: Review and allow the app's requests, then try again. Blocked requests won't run automatically.
triggerConsent.runtimeRequests: This app defines its requests while running. Your requests use this app's existing CraftBot conversation. Other users' requests stay in separate conversations. Local files and commands require the separate owner-access setting.
